name: Meeting notes
author: Eyad SibAI
description: Record meetings and browse your recordings and imported audio/video. Open transcripts, play audio, or request a Claude summary.

barWidget.description: Open your searchable meeting library or start a recording. Middle-click stops; right-click starts or stops instantly.

schema.label: Notes folder
schema.description: Each meeting is saved here as Markdown when it ends, named by date, time and title.

schema.label: Open notes with
schema.description: default: the app registered for Markdown files. editor: your Omarchy editor.

schema.label: Title from Akiflow
schema.description: When the Akiflow plugin is enabled, prefill the title with the meeting happening now or starting within 15 minutes.

schema.label: Summarize automatically
schema.description: Send each transcript to the configured summary provider when the meeting ends. Save the summary inside its recording folder and export a copy to the notes folder.

schema.label: Open live transcript window
schema.description: Open a separate full live transcript when starting a recording from the bar.
